title: XRECORD DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local XRECORD direct-codec transaction control across inline and detached handle streams

implementation.behavior: Build the typed/raw data block locally, then stage the effective body and handle destinations. Publish with swaps only after the data length/body, cloning field, common handle prefix, and trailing handles all succeed. Preserve inline string text-profile behavior and version-specific handle stream placement.

control.profile: Locally generated XRECORD containing heap-backed UTF-8 text, numeric and point values, a 300-byte binary value, a data-block handle, and a trailing handle-stream reference.
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller stream bytes, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same XRECORD and buffers then retry to output matching the clean encoding.

separate_baseline_failure.result: Fails at existing output-proof assertions, including expected/matched source-frame counts and strict-composed gates. Rebuilt and reproduced with source from HEAD~2, before this XRECORD change; therefore it is not evidence of an XRECORD transaction regression.
separate_baseline_failure.handling: Do not weaken the strict source/output gate or count this as a passing qualification. Retain as a separate current-test expectation/source-profile audit.
